summary: The prepared source already contains the reporter-confirmed fix from upstream PR 32219: KDAAttnBackend opts out of the unnecessary per-step CPU seq_lens mirror. Added focused regression coverage for the exact KDA/DSPARK scheduler contract and independent forced-host-mirror boundaries. The old True behavior fails the regression; the prepared False behavior passes.

tests.what_was_measured: Four scheduler-contract cases passed: KDA with DSPARK avoids the CPU seq_lens mirror; a host-consuming sibling, TBO, and ngram still force it; unset backend slots do not force it.

tests.command: temporary negative control: set KDAAttnBackend.needs_cpu_seq_lens=True, then run test_kda_cpu_seq_lens.py
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the restored pre-fix behavior failed the KDA/DSPARK and unset-slot regression cases. The temporary source edit was reverted.

One MI355X/gfx950 executed the production KDA Triton path; 10 subtests passed numerical comparison with the independent pure-PyTorch recurrence, including single-request extend and bsz=1 decode boundaries.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-17025c2d8ab2/raw/gpu_environment.txt identifies AMD Instinct MI355X, GFX Version gfx950; reports/j-17025c2d8ab2/raw/test_kda_triton_gfx950.txt records 10 passing KDA subtests.
remaining_limitations: The original 8xMI350X TP8 Kimi-K3 MXFP4 DSPARK serving workload and weights were unavailable. A single-GPU deterministic KDA fixture cannot reproduce or qualify the reported nondeterministic full-model hang. Original-scale resolution evidence comes from the issue reporter's ten c=1 rounds with the isolated fix.
